sweeps.name: topology-ep
sweeps.narrative: Expert parallelism should win at every width, and wider tp should beat wider dp on 10k-token prompts.

sweeps.name: batch-prefill
sweeps.narrative: The per-step token cap should set ITL, and chunking long prefills should trade throughput for ITL below it.

sweeps.name: kv-capacity
sweeps.narrative: fp8 KV should pay most where many resident 10k-token sequences make KV the binding resource.

sweeps.name: moe-collective
sweeps.narrative: The all2all gap should widen with EP width and per-step tokens, since 10k prompts push heavy dispatch volume.

sweeps.name: cudagraph
sweeps.narrative: FULL capture should edge PIECEWISE and NONE should lose heavily, by a similar margin at both fleet ends.

sweeps.name: routing
sweeps.narrative: Load- and KV-aware routing should beat random by more on 64 instances than on 8, as long prompts land unevenly.

objective: max output tok/s per accelerator subject to the scenario's SLOs
